requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL execute language semantics through explicit instruction-stack expansion rather than tree-walk recursive evaluation for compound AST nodes.

case.given: A RuntimeInterpreter fiber receives a parsed AST node through the public execution API
case.when: The runtime handles the node execution instruction
case.then: The handler SHALL expand the node into one or more RuntimeInstruction records on the current fiber instruction stack instead of recursively evaluating the whole node in the handler call.

case.given: A script uses block, function call, branch, loop, try-catch, object, property, subscript, workflow, or effect syntax
case.then: The runtime SHALL represent the remaining work for the compound form as explicit instructions and operand-stack frames.

case.given: A node is already a literal value or an evaluated runtime value
case.then: The runtime MAY lower it directly to a value-push instruction without introducing extra evaluator recursion.

case.given: A workflow safe-point is reached inside nested calls, loops, or try-catch blocks
case.then: The checkpoint SHALL contain enough instruction stack, operand stack, environment, fiber, and control-frame state to resume without relying on the original JavaScript call stack.

case.given: A checkpoint is captured in the middle of a loop body
case.when: The runtime hydrates and resumes the checkpoint
case.then: The next iteration, break, continue, and loop-local binding behavior SHALL be driven by restored instructions and frames.

case.given: A checkpoint is captured inside a try body or finally body
case.when: The runtime hydrates and resumes the checkpoint
case.then: The active catch, finally, and pending abrupt-completion behavior SHALL be represented by restored instructions and frames.

case.given: A caller uses existing RuntimeInterpreter public entry points
case.then: The public entry points SHALL remain available and return the same results for existing RuntimeInterpreter tests.

case.given: The parser has already been synchronized with current Kon syntax
case.then: The parser syntax and parser output contracts SHALL NOT be changed as part of this track.

case.given: The old Interpreter implementation remains in the project
case.then: The new RuntimeInterpreter SHALL NOT depend on old Interpreter runtime state or old ExtensionRegistry globals for ordinary execution.
